title: scrape_runs
description: Execution log for one scrape of one scope.

scope_id.description: Database id of the scrape scope, if available.

scope_name.description: Scope name copied onto the run for stable logs.

finished_at.description: Run finish timestamp. Null while the run is still active.

status.description: Run outcome. Missing listings are only marked from success runs.

search_url.description: Initial search URL used for the scrape.

pages_fetched.description: Number of search result pages fetched.

listings_seen.description: Number of listings parsed in this run.

new_listings.description: Listings first seen during this run.

changed_listings.description: Existing listings whose meaningful content_hash changed during this run.

missing_marked.description: Existing listings covered by this scope that were not seen in this successful run and had missing_count incremented.

alerts_sent.description: Notifications sent from candidates found in this run.

error_message.description: Failure detail when the run fails or partially fails.
